deploy-bot: Deploy finished to canary: service=eng-inference, image=redwood/inference:2026-03-15-2c9b, rollout=canary(10%). started by sarah

incident-bot: :rotating_light: Potential incident detected: error_rate(service=eng-inference,route=/generate) over threshold (5m)  18% 5xx, baseline 0.4%

alex (on-call): Paging on-call for eng-inference canary failures. I'm looking now.

sarah (release-engineer): that's my canary. I ran the KMS key rotation earlier this morning and updated secrets in the secrets-store job. I thought the deploy picked it up.

miguel (backend): logs show a ton of KMS errors during token fetch: `AccessDeniedException: User is not authorized to perform: kms:Decrypt on resource arn:aws:kms:...:alias/redwood-prod-inference`

alex (on-call): grabbing logs from canary pod:```
# kubectl logs -n prod eng-inference-canary-7f9f
2026-03-15T14:03:12Z ERROR failed to decrypt model-key: AccessDeniedException: User: arn:...:role/ecsTaskExecutionRole is not authorized to perform: kms:Decrypt on resource arn:aws:kms:...:alias/redwood-prod-inference
```

sarah (release-engineer): ugh, we rotated the key earlier and created a new alias, but the deploy manifest in CI referenced the hard alias `alias/redwood-prod-inference-v2` instead of the new `alias/redwood-prod-inference`. I missed updating the deploy template in the release pipeline.

alex (on-call): That explains it. Canary can't decrypt TLS/client keys to handshake to model store -> 5xx for generation calls. How widespread?

miguel (backend): Canary only right now (10% traffic). But the canary autoscale brought up more pods and they're all failing handshakes -> returning 502/503 upstream. Metrics show 10% of all /generate requests failing overall because of traffic split.

liz (prod-sre): Marking as P1 and notifying on-call rotation. incident-bot: INCIDENT CREATED (P1)  Incident ID INC-20260315-001. Command `incident-bot status` for updates.

alex (on-call): Immediate mitigation options: 1) flip feature flag `inference-canary-rollout` to 0 (kill-switch) to route all traffic away from canary back to stable; 2) patch canary env var to point to correct KMS alias (quick hotfix) then restart pods; 3) rollback the deploy image to previous stable image. Thoughts?

sarah (release-engineer): quickest is flip the flag. I can patch the pipeline and trigger a hotfix but that will take ~8-12m to rollout. If we kill the canary now we stop customer impact immediately.

miguel (backend): kill-switch please. Also, add an override on the load balancer to prevent any session to canary while we fix the config.

alex (on-call): Doing kill-switch now. `ops-bot` please route-check + set flag.

ops-bot: `ops-bot` executed: feature flag `inference-canary-rollout` set to 0 by alex at 14:07:22Z  traffic shifted to stable (90%).

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Traffic shift completed. Error rate on /generate dropping. Monitoring: error_rate 5m -> 0.9% (was 18%).

liz (prod-sre): Good. Now we need a durable fix. Sarah, can you patch the deploy manifest in CI to reference the correct KMS alias and trigger a hotfix? Also verify IAM role permissions for the new alias.

sarah (release-engineer): On it. Steps: 1) update deploy template in `infra/ci/deploy.yml` to use `{{ secrets.kms_alias }}` (which now resolves to the new alias), 2) update terraform KMS alias resource to ensure both aliases point to same key for short window, 3) run `ci/hotfix-deploy --env=prod --image=redwood/inference:stable-2026-03-12` to force stable if needed. I'll push the change and trigger a hotfix.

alex (on-call): While sarah does that, can someone confirm the IAM role used by tasks has `kms:Decrypt` permission for the new alias?

miguel (backend): Checking IAM policy now... `aws iam simulate-principal-policy` output: currently denies Decrypt for alias `redwood-prod-inference` because alias resource ARN not included. I can add a resource entry quickly.

sarah (release-engineer): I added a fallback alias in terraform and applied it. Also updated the CI deploy template. Hotfix deploy in progress.

deploy-bot: Hotfix pipeline started by sarah  job id 71234. Rolling to canary (should be stable image pinned to `stable-2026-03-12`).

migrating logs show:```
2026-03-15T14:18:40Z INFO KMS alias alias/redwood-prod-inference now points to key-id 1234abcd
2026-03-15T14:19:05Z INFO IAM policy updated: added kms:Decrypt on arn:aws:kms:...:alias/redwood-prod-inference for role ecsTaskExecutionRole
```

alex (on-call): Hotfix completed?

sarah (release-engineer): Hotfix pipeline finished at 14:21:30Z. Can revert the feature flag and/or redeploy canary after verification.

ops-bot: traffic-check: /generate error_rate 5m -> 0.5% (back to baseline). Latency normal.

alex (on-call): Reverting kill-switch now. ops-bot, enable canary rollout to 10% again.

ops-bot: `inference-canary-rollout` set to 10% by alex at 14:22:18Z.

incident-bot: Monitoring: no regression after 20m of canary traffic. Incident status: mitigated.

liz (prod-sre): Handoff: alex -> liz. I will take postmortem and lead follow-ups. Alex, summarize timeline for the handoff.

alex (on-call): Summary: 14:03 detect high 5xx during canary. 14:05 identified KMS Decrypt AccessDenied caused by alias mismatch after key rotation. 14:07 killed canary (feature flag) to stop impact. 14:18 sarah applied alias fix + IAM permission update, triggered hotfix. 14:21 hotfix complete, 14:22 restored canary to 10%. Customers affected: small subset on canary  estimated 8% of active requests during window (~approx 240 failed requests total during incident window). No major customers reported persistent errors; monitoring showed error spike lasted ~18 minutes.

liz (prod-sre): Taking it. Immediate action items logged below. Will create INC-20260315-001 ticket and link to postmortem doc.

liz (prod-sre): Action items (short):
- Ensure CI deploy templates do not hardcode KMS aliases (owner: sarah, due: 2026-03-17)
- Add pre-deploy check that validates KMS alias referenced exists and IAM role can call kms:Decrypt (owner: infra, due: 2026-03-18)
- Add a temporary terraform alias mapping for 48h post-rotation to prevent cutovers (owner: infra, due: immediate)
- Improve monitoring alert to include KMS Decrypt error patterns and link to runbook (owner: monitoring, due: 2026-03-20)

incident-bot: Incident INC-20260315-001 status changed to RESOLVED (mitigated) by liz at 14:46:10Z  follow-ups required.

sarah (release-engineer): Sorry for the gap  will own the deploy template fix and follow-ups. Thanks everyone for the fast response.

alex (on-call): Thanks team. I'll add notes to the on-call handoff doc.

liz (prod-sre): Closing thread here; will open postmortem doc and link back. If anyone has additional logs/alerts, paste them into INC-20260315-001.

sarah (release-engineer): FYI: I also opened a PR to change CI variables to reference `secrets.kms_alias` instead of hard alias  reviewers @miguel @liz

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Thread archived to incident INC-20260315-001.
